gloss: the press corps; group of reporters

definitions.gloss: the press corps; the assembled reporters
definitions.explanation: The reporters covering an event or a public figure, treated as a single body. Most often seen in the phrase {記者団|きしゃだん}に{語|かた}る, describing informal remarks made to waiting journalists.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{記者団|きしゃだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: The prime minister answered the reporters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{官邸|かんてい}→官邸：12305_kantei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{記者団|きしゃだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{待|ま}っていた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: The press corps was waiting in front of the official residence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{記者団|きしゃだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}し→対する：02126_taisuru⟧、「⟦{現時点|げんじてん}→現時点：13556_genjiten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦{決|き}まっていない→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: The minister told reporters, "Nothing has been decided at this point."

notes:
⟦{記者|きしゃ}→記者：14170_kisha⟧ (reporter) plus ⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group, body). Journalistic vocabulary; you will meet it constantly in news reports but rarely in conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記者団|きしゃだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to speak to reporters
- {記者団|きしゃだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}し→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧: to state to the press corps
- {記者団|きしゃだん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれる→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧: to be surrounded by reporters
- {記者団|きしゃだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}える→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧: to take reporters' questions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧: press conference — a formal arranged event; talking to the {記者団|きしゃだん} is typically impromptu, in a corridor or doorway
- ⟦マスコミ→マスコミ：03872_masukomi⟧: the mass media — the industry as a whole, not the reporters present at one place
